escalation_reason: Whether uv should add s390x and ppc64le (and manylinux variants) as --python-platform targets is a product decision for maintainers, even though the platform-tags crate already supports the architectures.
rationale: The reporter asks for new --python-platform values (s390x-unknown-linux-gnu, powerpc64le-unknown-linux-gnu, and manylinux variants) that the CLI currently rejects. Nothing is broken: uv works as designed for the supported targets, and the request is for new behaviour, so this is an enhancement. The reporter's template label is absent, so there is no label to differ from. Two searches for python-platform and architecture-target requests found no matching duplicate; #18127 concerns platform_machine marker evaluation on cross-arch setups, a different problem. The request is well specified and needs no reproduction. Escalated because adding targets is a maintainer call.
